title: Pricing & your stay
description: Compare private and shared accommodation for Primal Reset Retreats on Hawaiʻi Island and preview your package and deposit.
heading: Make space
intro: Choose how you stay. Explore real room photos and see your package price, planned deposit, and remaining balance in one place.
hero_alt: Pacific waves meet the volcanic coastline on Hawaiʻi Island
room_intro: Two ways to experience the same reset. Prices are per person for the retreat package, not a nightly room rate. Specific room assignments and final inclusions will be confirmed before reservations open.
promo_description: Have a code from Open Gate? Apply it before the planned deposit is calculated.
balance_note: Due date to be confirmed before booking
availability_note: 5 private rooms and 16 shared beds are the planned total allotments, not live remaining availability. Choosing a room here does not reserve it.
booking_note: Pricing preview only. Payments are not open. Final room arrangements, package inclusions, any applicable fees, and booking, cancellation, and refund terms will be confirmed before a deposit is accepted.
closing_heading: Your reset is more than a room.
closing_text: Simple spaces, volcanic land, and room to breathe. Whether you choose more privacy or a shared stay, Open Gate is the base for the same experience of movement, reflection, and connection.
